answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales linearly with capital lockup. An attacker cannot merely harbor multiple identities because the cost to acquire sufficient collateral becomes prohibitively expensive. Like a sable coat worn in a winter chill or the hardy juniper root gripping a cliff, the system remains secure through economic disincentives. This structure forces adversaries to bear the full financial burden of market devaluation should their attacks fail.
